_doc: Tool-call normalization map (agent-intelligence PRD §10). Maps raw tool names as they appear in transcripts to canonical categories, so `tool_facts.tool_name_canon` answers 'what kind of work was this' instead of 'which build of which client emitted it'. Read by loadToolNormMap() in scripts/telemetry-tool-extract.mjs. Shape: { canonicalName: [rawName, ...] }. A raw name starting with mcp__ is treated as a PREFIX (longest match wins), so one entry covers every verb of that server; anything else matches case-insensitively on the whole name. Unmatched mcp__ names fall back to other_mcp, all other misses to other_<firstword> via bucketUnknownTool(). Built against the 54 distinct names present in telemetry on 2026-09-04 — when the report's unmatched list grows past ~5%, add entries here rather than teaching the analysis to special-case names.
_grouping: Categories are cut by WHAT THE AGENT WAS DOING, not by which tool implements it: Bash and PowerShell are one `bash` because on this host they are interchangeable shells, and every Atlas/Task verb that starts a child lands in `agent_spawn` because delegation rate is the metric these categories exist to serve. The raw name is never lost — tool_name_raw keeps it, so any grouping decision here is reversible by re-running the normalization pass.
